privacy.encryptionDesc: Data encrypted in transit and at rest. Quote files are read in memory and never stored; the extracted text is removed after Deep Analysis, at close, or after 90 days.

about.card3Desc: Your vendor pricing is confidential. We built TermLift with that in mind from day one — encrypted, never trained on, quote files never stored.

settingsClient.retentionTitle: What we keep, and for how long
settingsClient.retentionFiles: Quote files are read in memory and never stored.
settingsClient.retentionText: The text extracted from a quote is removed once Deep Analysis completes, when the deal closes, or {days} days after upload at the latest. The analysis itself stays until you delete the deal.
settingsClient.retentionDocs: Documents you attach for the negotiation service are removed {grace} days after the case closes, or {months} months after upload at the latest.
settingsClient.retentionDelete: Deleting a deal or your account removes its data and documents immediately.

privacyPage.summary1: Quote files are read in memory and never stored. We keep the text we extract only temporarily, and the analysis until you delete the deal.
privacyPage.summary2: Extracted quote text goes when Deep Analysis completes, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload — whichever comes first.
privacyPage.summary5: You can delete your account and all associated data anytime, including any document you asked us to keep for a negotiation.
privacyPage.s2Deal1: Text extracted from your uploaded quote (kept temporarily — see Data Retention)
privacyPage.s2Deal4: If you use the negotiation service and attach a quote or contract: the document itself, for the duration of the case (see Data Retention)
privacyPage.s3Item5: Improve the service based on aggregated usage patterns tied to your account id, never to your documents
privacyPage.s3Item8: Build de-identified pricing benchmarks from the outcomes of closed negotiations: vendor, product, price, term and the month of close. A benchmark row carries no name, email, account, deal or document reference. It is pseudonymised rather than anonymous, it is reviewed by a person before it is added, and it remains after the deal or account it came from is deleted
privacyPage.s4PostHogDesc: Product analytics tied to your account id. We do not send your email address, vendor names, amounts from your documents or any document content to PostHog.
privacyPage.s5Item1: Read in memory and never stored. A final document you upload when closing a deal is read the same way; we keep only its SHA-256 fingerprint, file type and the figures we read from it
privacyPage.s5Item2: Kept on the deal while a Deep Analysis may still need it, then removed: when Deep Analysis completes, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload, whichever comes first
privacyPage.s5Item3: Analysis results, structured deal facts (vendor, product, totals, term) and outcomes are kept until you delete the deal or your account
privacyPage.s5Item4: Removed 30 days after the negotiation closes, and never later than 12 months after upload
privacyPage.s5Item5: Kept until you delete your account
privacyPage.s5Item6: IP addresses and error details are removed after 90 days; token and cost counts are kept without them
privacyPage.s5Item7: De-identified outcome rows (section 3) are kept after the deal they came from is deleted
privacyPage.s5Note: We do not sell or share your data with advertisers. When you delete a deal or your account, its rows and documents are removed from our database and storage at once; our providers' own operational logs age out on their schedules, and de-identified benchmark rows remain.

termsPage.s2Item5: Uploaded quote files are discarded after processing; the extracted text is kept temporarily under the retention rules in the Privacy Policy
termsPage.s6YourContentDesc: You own what you upload. By using the service, you grant us a limited license to process your content to provide the analysis and, where you ask for it, the negotiation service, and to derive de-identified pricing benchmarks from the outcomes of closed deals as described in the Privacy Policy. We don't claim ownership of your documents.
termsPage.s8Item4: On termination your right to use the service ends immediately. Export anything you need before deleting your account: deletion is immediate and permanent

securityPage.keyPrinciple: Quote files are read in memory and never stored. The extracted text is kept only until Deep Analysis has run, the deal closes or 90 days pass; the analysis itself stays until you delete it.
securityPage.step1Desc: We read the text from your PDF or image. The file is held in memory only.
securityPage.step3Desc: The original file is discarded when the request ends. It never reaches our database or storage.
securityPage.bottomLineDesc: Your original quote files are never stored. The extracted text is temporary; the analysis is yours until you delete it.
securityPage.fileDeletionDesc1: When you upload a quote, we read its text in memory and discard the file when the request ends. It is never written to a database or to storage. Our application logs record the size of what the AI returned, never its content.
securityPage.fileDeletionDesc2: If you ask TermLift to negotiate for you and attach a document, that file is stored with your consent and removed 30 days after the case closes, or 12 months after upload at the latest.
securityPage.extractedTextDesc1: The text extracted from your quote is stored with the deal so Deep Analysis can run later without a re-upload. It is not a permanent copy: it is removed once Deep Analysis completes, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload at the latest.
securityPage.extractedTextDesc2: What stays is the AI-generated analysis, the structured deal facts (vendor, product, totals, term) and the outcome you record. You can delete any deal at any time.
securityPage.aiTrainingDesc2: We also don't use your data to train any models ourselves. Outcomes of closed negotiations may become de-identified benchmark rows (vendor, product, price, term, month of close), reviewed by a person and stripped of any account, deal or document reference. That is a pricing dataset, not training data, and the Privacy Policy describes it.
securityPage.gdprDesc2: Our database and file storage are hosted in the EU (Supabase, eu-west-1). Processing happens where our providers run: our application on Vercel in the US and AI analysis at Anthropic in the US, under Standard Contractual Clauses.
securityPage.ctaSubtitle: Your quote files are never stored. Extracted text is temporary, and the analysis stays only as long as you keep the deal.

privacy.a1: Yes. Quote files are read in memory and never stored. The extracted text stays with the deal only until Deep Analysis has run, the deal closes, or 90 days pass; the analysis itself stays until you delete the deal. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Your documents are never used for AI training.
privacy.a4: Yes. Go to your profile settings and choose 'Delete account.' Your account, saved deals, analysis history and any document you uploaded for the negotiation service are removed immediately. De-identified benchmark rows built from closed deals carry no link to your account and remain. This cannot be undone.
